# Kuicksilver

> QUIC, HTTP/3, Kotlin Multiplatform: a QUIC and HTTP/3 library with a Ktor client and server engine, for Android, iOS, JVM, Native (Linux, macOS, Windows), on a statically linked, signature-checked OpenSSL 4.1.

Features: HTTP/3, HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 in the Ktor engines; Alt-Svc discovery with an HTTP/3 and TCP protocol race and fallback to TCP (adaptive TCP and QUIC); WebTransport over HTTP/3 (draft-17; servers also take drafts 16, 14 and 02, clients also offer 16 and 02); QUIC datagrams (RFC 9221) and HTTP datagrams (RFC 9297); Encrypted Client Hello (ECH, RFC 9849); CONNECT-UDP proxying (RFC 9298, MASQUE); 0-RTT; connection migration; qlog. RFC-strict (one compliance row per requirement), interop-tested against msquic, ngtcp2, picoquic, quic-go, quiche and quinn. The feature list with links: the README's "Features" section.

Published on Maven Central under `io.kuicksilver` (Apache-2.0). Modules: kuicksilver-native (the `ksl` C shim and OpenSSL), kuicksilver-tls, kuicksilver-ktor-network, kuicksilver-quic, kuicksilver-http3, kuicksilver-http2, kuicksilver-ktor-client (`HttpClient(Kuicksilver)`), kuicksilver-ktor-server (`embeddedServer(Kuicksilver)`), and the kuicksilver-bom.

## Docs

- [Everything in one file](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/llms-full.txt): all the guides above concatenated (generated by tools/check/llms-full.sh)
- [README](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/README.md): what Kuicksilver is, the dependency lines, swapping the Ktor engine, the platform table, the feature list with the page behind each feature, the samples
- [Install](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/install.md): Gradle setups for JVM, Android, Kotlin Multiplatform with iOS, Kotlin/Native and Swift only; the modules; supported Ktor versions
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/quickstart.md): the dependencies, a first Ktor client call and a first HTTP/3 server with a local test certificate (PKCS#8 key), and what the engines do by default
- [TLS guide](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/tls.md): TLS configuration, trust (platform verifier, RFC 9525 host name check, pins), TLS over sockets, key logging
- [QUIC guide](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/quic.md): QUIC connections, streams, datagrams, migration, admission and connection limits, the coroutine API
- [HTTP/3 guide](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/http3.md): HTTP/3 and QPACK over kuicksilver-quic
- [Ktor engines](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/ktor.md): the start of the Ktor engine guides: the production first screen of each engine, the imports of every engine page, the map of the engine pages, supported Ktor versions
- [Ktor client engine](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/client.md): `HttpClient(Kuicksilver)`: the mobile first screen, timeouts, HTTP/2 and h2c on the client, the connection pool, coalescing, Happy Eyeballs, name resolution
- [HTTP/3 in the Ktor client](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/client-http3.md): discovery modes, Alt-Svc and HTTPS records, the HTTP/3 and TCP race and the fallback to TCP, stalled connections, the remote kill switch, connection migration
- [Proxies in the Ktor client](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/client-proxies.md): system proxy settings, PAC, explicit HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS proxies, credentials, HTTP/3 through a CONNECT-UDP proxy
- [Ktor server engine](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/server.md): `embeddedServer(Kuicksilver)`: the TLS connector, connection limits, HTTP/3 and HTTP/2 on the server, h2c, turning HTTP/3 off, the CONNECT-UDP proxy, graceful stop
- [Behind a proxy or load balancer](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/server-proxies.md): misdirected requests (421) and the PROXY protocol
- [Configuration file (EngineMain)](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/server-config-file.md): `application.conf` keys of the server engine and how they map to the DSL
- [TLS in the Ktor engines](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/engine-tls.md): certificate pinning, mutual TLS, certificate reload, SNI, TLS 1.2 on the server, Encrypted Client Hello
- [WebSockets, WebTransport and priorities](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/realtime.md): WebSockets over HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, permessage-deflate, WebTransport sessions on both engines, request priorities
- [Observability and diagnostics](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/observability.md): loggers, event listeners, qlog, metrics; why a request did not use HTTP/3; which connection served a call; why a call failed
- [HTTP/2 on the client](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/client.md#http2-on-the-client): HTTP/2 over TCP for the Ktor client (ALPN `h2`, settings, HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED fallback)
- [HTTP/2 on the server](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/server.md#http2-on-the-server): HTTP/2 next to HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/3 on one TLS connector, on by default since 0.3.0, flood limits
- [0-RTT](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/zero-rtt.md): the one page on 0-RTT: when it helps, turning it on in the Ktor client and server, what must not run early, how the server limits replays, checking that it works, the QUIC and HTTP/3 API names
- [Migrating from OkHttp and Retrofit](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/migrating-from-okhttp.md): OkHttp settings mapped to the Ktor client with Kuicksilver (timeouts, certificate pinning, interceptors, pool, cookies, cache), what is different, and the options for Retrofit
- [Migrating from another Ktor engine](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/migrating-ktor-engines.md): swapping the CIO, OkHttp, Android or Darwin client engine and the Netty, CIO or Jetty server engine for Kuicksilver
- [Deploying the HTTP/3 server](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/deployment.md): UDP and TCP on one port, Alt-Svc, firewalls, Docker, Kubernetes, load balancers and proxies, UDP buffers, GSO, checking a deployment
- [iOS guide](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/ios.md): using Kuicksilver from iOS and Swift
- [App Store](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/app-store.md): publishing an app that embeds Kuicksilver on the App Store
- [Building from source](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/building.md): the native build scripts, adding your own compiler and flags (CC, CPPFLAGS, CFLAGS, LDFLAGS), and why releases are built without them
- [Glossary](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/glossary.md): origin, alternative, Alt-Svc, route, race, broken alternative, ALPN, SPKI, ksl, accelerated and portable socket, loop, Initial and Retry, 4-tuple, connection ID, QUIC-LB, PROXY protocol
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/configuration.md): every option by configuration block with its type, default, release, stability status and security marker; the first-screen options of each engine, the configuration-file keys and the migration tables from 0.2.x
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md): symptoms by exact error text or code (handshake timeout, certificate errors, ALPN mismatch, CONNECTION_REFUSED and connection limits, 0-RTT, HTTP/3 fallback reasons, HTTP/2 failures) with cause and action

## Samples

- [kq command line](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/samples/kq-cli/README.md): a curl-like command line on the Ktor client engine, a native executable for macOS, Linux and Windows: kq get|head with --http3/--http2/--http1.1, -v (protocol and why, the QUIC connection, Alt-Svc learned), --qlog, --alt-svc
- [HTTP/3 server](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/samples/http3-server/README.md): an HTTP/3 Ktor server from EngineMain and application.conf: TLS from PEM files, Alt-Svc, HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 on the same port, the PROXY protocol behind HAProxy or nginx, curl --http3
- [WebTransport chat](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/samples/webtransport-chat/README.md): a Ktor WebTransport server and a common-code client: a bidirectional stream for messages, datagrams for typing indicators, close codes, slow readers, graceful stop
- [Real-time telemetry](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/samples/realtime-telemetry/README.md): a QUIC application on kuicksilver-quic: stream priorities, datagrams, connection migration, tests over MemoryNetwork
- [Compose Multiplatform demo](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/samples/compose-demo/README.md): an Android and iOS app whose HTTP/3 download survives a network switch that breaks TCP

## Policies

- [API stability](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/stability.md): stable and experimental API, ABI checks, supported platforms, Ktor and OpenSSL policies
- [Development process](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/process.md): how every change is checked before a release: failing-first tests, review against the RFC text, the local gate on every target, hosted CI, soak, fuzzing, signed releases with SBOM and provenance
- [Why Kuicksilver, and why not](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/why-kuicksilver.md): against Cronet, URLSession, OkHttp, Netty QUIC, quiche and quic-go, with sources: platforms, protocol features, performance, size, maturity, API stability
- [How we verify](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/how-we-verify.md): RFC conformance tables, interop, fuzzing, the release gate, hosted CI, soak, threat model, reproducible builds, with the numbers and their dates
- [Verifying a release](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/docs/verifying.md): signatures, Gradle dependency verification, SBOM and provenance, reproducible native libraries

## Optional

- [Security policy](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/SECURITY.md): reporting vulnerabilities, OpenSSL update commitments
- [Changelog](https://github.com/kuicksilver/kuicksilver/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): changes per release
